name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality, durable, and low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) interior paints from reputable brands. The specific type of paint (e.g., latex, acrylic) and finish (e.g., matte, eggshell, satin) is chosen based on the area being painted, its expected use, and your aesthetic preferences. For high-traffic areas or spaces prone to moisture like bathrooms and kitchens, we recommend paints with enhanced durability and mold resistance. We discuss all available options and provide recommendations during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use high-quality, low-VOC interior paints from reputable brands, selected based on the room's use and your preferred finish.
